title: Plague King Over Black Peak
description: A surreal black and white line drawing of a crowned plague doctor-like figure with multiple arms and glowing rings stands within fractured geometric panels at the top center. Below is a solid black mountain shape covered with colorful translucent circles in purple, green, red and gold, along with small sketchy human figures and ink splatters.
prompt: Surreal collage featuring a crowned plague doctor king with multiple arms and glowing rings, drawn in intricate black and white linework inside fractured geometric panels at the top. Below is a solid black mountain silhouette covered in overlapping translucent colorful orbs in purple green red and gold, with tiny sketchy human figures scattered throughout, ink splatters and stains on aged paper, dark occult atmosphere, high contrast.
